question:
**Select the most appropriate homonym of the underlined word to fill in the blank.**

He was __complimented__ for his appearance. His shirt _____________ his trousers perfectly.
solution:
The correct answer is "**complemented.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Homonym" means a word that sounds the same or is spelled the same as another word but has a different meaning.
 
 
• Example: Bark (the sound a dog makes) and Bark (the covering of a tree).
 
 
 
• **In the given sentence, the word "complemented" would be the appropriate homonym of the word "complimented."**
 
• **Complement means to complete or enhance something by adding to it. (**पूरक)
 
• The sentence means that the shirt and trousers looked good together, so complemented is the correct word to use.
 
• The correct sentence would be: He was** complimented** for his appearance. His shirt **complemented **his trousers perfectly. 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 1 "competed" means to take part in a contest or rivalry. (प्रतियोगिता)
 
• In option 2 "complement" means to complete or enhance something by adding to it.(पूरक)
 
• In option 3 "commented" means to express an opinion or remark about something.(टिप्पणी)
